content: {"like":["Enjoys nostalgic 1960s heist films like The Italian Job for their classic vibe","Prefers well‑executed Westerns with vivid color and strong cast performances","Values high‑quality sound in sci‑fi adventure films such as Journey to the Center of the Earth","Appreciates vintage spy thrillers that clearly portray Soviet antagonists","Likes collections featuring iconic actors like James Stewart in period Westerns"],"dislike":["Dislikes films with excessive or gratuitous sexual content, as in American Guns","Rejects movies with poor or distracting color grading, e.g., full‑screen Bend of the River","Avoids commentary tracks that feel snobbish or disrespectful to the film","Dislikes overacting by major stars in war epics like The Longest Day","Finds films with weak or meandering plots, such as The Rare Breed, unappealing"]}
